fixtures/CHANGELOG.md:15:5:Changelog.ChangeTypeAlias:Use 'Added', not 'New Features': it's one of the six change types.
fixtures/CHANGELOG.md:17:18:ReleaseNotes.Simply:Drop 'Just': it tells the reader this is simple.
fixtures/CHANGELOG.md:17:55:ReleaseNotes.Easy:'easy' is the reader's call to make. Show the steps instead.
fixtures/CHANGELOG.md:19:5:Changelog.ChangeType:'Improvements' isn't a change type. Use Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed, Fixed, or Security.
fixtures/CHANGELOG.md:21:3:Changelog.Vague:'Various improvements' says nothing a reader can act on. Name what changed.
